CONTRACT getClientInvestmentBreakdown GET /v1/client/investment-breakdown: {asOfDate, funds:[{fundId,fundName,status:ready|preparing, sips:[{scheduleId,state:active|ended,investedPaise,valuePaise,growthPaise,simpleReturnBasisPoints|null,xirrBasisPoints|null,monthsPaid,monthsTotal}], oneTime:[{entryId,effectiveDate,investedPaise,valuePaise,growthPaise,simpleReturnBasisPoints|null,reversed}], lines:[{kind:other_adjustments,valuePaise}]}]}. Funds by name, active SIP first, one-time newest first; preparing funds carry empty arrays.

CONTRACT listAdminInvestmentsToCategorise GET /v1/admin/investments/to-categorise?after&limit (client_values.read): {clientCount, items:[{userId,name,waitingRecordings,fundsNeedingSplit}]} + meta.page.

CONTRACT getAdminClientInvestments GET /v1/admin/clients/{userId}/investments: {userId, funds:[{fundId,fundName,status, investments:[{ref,label,date|null,amountPaise,reversed}], uncategorised:[{entryId,effectiveDate,amountPaise,reasonLabel}], earlierGrowth:{totalPaise,cutoffEntryId,needsConfirmation,proposal:[{ref,amountPaise}],confirmed:{splitId,cutoffEntryId,totalPaise,parts,confirmedAt}|null}|null}]}. ref = {kind:sip,scheduleId}|{kind:one_time,allocationId}.

CONTRACT confirmAdminEarlierGrowthSplit POST /v1/admin/clients/{userId}/funds/{fundId}/earlier-growth-split (client_position.write, Idempotency-Key): body {cutoffEntryId, parts:[{ref,amountPaise}] max 200}; 201 {fundId, split:{...}}. 409 STATE_CONFLICT: uncategorised recordings in fund, nothing to split, or stale cutoff (reload). 400 VALIDATION_FAILED fields parts / parts.N. Zero total needs empty parts. Audited, no email.

Shape differences from plan: clientCount and needsConfirmation added; one-time client id is entryId (investment-architecture guard forbids allocationId in client routes); investments item is {ref,label,date,amountPaise,reversed}.

For V4/V5: domain/client/investmentBreakdown.ts foldFundBreakdown(input,fundId,asOf) -> status, preparingReason (uncategorised|uncovered_growth|sum_mismatch), positionValue/InvestedPaise, sips, oneTime (entryId, allocationId), lines, stakes[{ref sip|one_time|uncategorised, investedPaise, valuePaise, present, reversed, firstDate}], uncategorisedEntryIds, uncoveredEntryIds. Also foldInvestmentBreakdown, fundStatus, toCategorise, proposeSplitByValue, refKey. Loader repositories/investmentBreakdownRepository.ts loadBreakdownInput(db,userId).

V4: write client_growth_parts in the same transaction as the growth entry; a deferred trigger refuses parts not summing to value_delta_paise, and parts on non-growth entries. Single-investment test for released apps = stakes with present true count == 1 (uncategorised count as stakes).

V5: an exit withdrawal no larger than the SIP's value goes entirely to the SIP (its principal delta lowers SIP invested); write principal portion = SIP invested. sip_early_exits CHECK amount_paise = value_before_paise still holds if value_before is the SIP value.

Spec readings to check: (1) 'investments on that entry's date' read as ledger order (held when the growth was written), so backdated recordings never re-flag and reversals never rewrite attribution; (2) extra table client_earlier_growth_split_entries stores the covered entries so a split survives one-time->SIP and reversals; (3) SIP XIRR also counts the SIP's share of maturity withdrawals as money back; (4) pre-0.18.4 whole-holding early exits: excess over SIP value spreads over the fund's other investments by value; (5) BreakdownInput has no maturitySettlements (they are ledger entries); (6) a split is refused while the fund has uncategorised recordings.

Not done by decision: review item 4 (negative recordings) - a recording cannot be negative: client_value_entries_contribution_shape (018) requires principal > 0 and value = principal, and the API uses positivePaiseSchema; lowering is a reversal, which categorise and link already refuse. Record-time category for corrections stays refused (only the categorise/link writes widened).

Rule 11: 078 is add-only; previous release ignores it; no existing response gains a key or enum value. Widened categorising makes released admin apps show corrections (and any sip_installment collection) as linkable/markable in the existing list, with existing keys.

DEPLOY note text: 'Migration 078 adds four append-only tables (growth parts, earlier-growth splits, split parts, split entries) and changes no existing row, column or constraint; 0.18.3 runs against it and an images-only rollback leaves them in place. After deploy every client fund reads Your breakdown is being prepared by BeOnEdge. until admins categorise its recordings and confirm any earlier-growth split. Growth written by 0.18.3 after a rollback is untargeted and may need a new split after roll-forward.'

Emulator (dev, Rahul Kumar) once V2/V3 land: admin Overview shows him under Investments to categorise if he has uncategorised recordings; his Ledger tab lists them (corrections too); categorise, confirm any Earlier growth panel; client Portfolio Breakdown then shows SIP and one-time blocks adding up to the fund value, else the preparing line.
